name_reason: Name is fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + battle core-table domain, summon_anim_variant_c descriptor, 5slot is a meaningful array dimension (5 ring slots), y_coord_array reflects role + array data type. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching 0x54068 or any data address; 'c' = variant-C label, '5' = slot count). Live Ghidra symbol (USER_DEFINED) is byte-identical to this name; src declaration matches.
purpose: Per-slot computed y-coordinate array for the variant-C 5-slot radial summon-spell animation; one int per ring slot.
logic_summary: Five int32 ring-slot y-coordinates. In the radial-blit phase (state_code 1/2/7/8) of fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial each slot is written y_coord[i] = round(angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0) (FMUL [0x5022b]=1.2, FADD [0x50233]=30.0), then read back and combined with x_coord[i], origin_y, and row_stride to form the blit destination. The state-3 transition also copies y_coord[4]->y_coord[2] and stores the angle_accumulator into y_coord[4]. Used signed (negative on the lower half of the sin ring; multiplied by row_stride via IMUL).
element_semantics: Each element is one ring slot's computed pixel y-coordinate = round(angle_accumulator * sin(angle_rad) * 1.2 + 30.0); signed (may be negative), later scaled by row_stride and offset by origin_y to index the framebuffer.
notes: BSS/zero-init (memory @ 0x54068 all 0x00). xrefs: WRITE @ 0x2704c + READs @ 0x2708d/0x270ce/0x27172/0x2723b, plus the state-3 swap touches y[2]/y[4] directly; all xrefs are inside fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_c_5slot_radial (0x26e39, dispatch-table entry #6, no direct CALL callers). Non-const: the game writes it every radial-blit frame and in the state-3 transition. Ghidra data plate already present and accurate; src comment block (lines 1170-1184) already precise and consistent with the plate, so both kept unchanged. anisummn.c NOT edited (comment keep).
